name: trueline
description: Trace with a pen tablet, export dimensionally-accurate DXF/SVG/PDF
author: TrueLine

scripts.test: node tests/run-tests.mjs && node tests/workflows.mjs && node tests/mask-contours.mjs && node tests/trace-input.mjs && node tests/static-server.cjs && node tests/autotrace.mjs && node tests/autotrace-edge-cases.mjs && node tests/outline-editor.mjs && node tests/native-save.cjs && node tests/mac-desktop.cjs
scripts.dist: node build/pack.mjs && tar -a -c -f dist/TrueLine-win-x64.zip -C dist TrueLine-win32-x64
scripts.test:autotrace:complex: node tests/complex-photo-cases.mjs && node tests/complex-photo-accuracy.mjs && node tests/precision-photo-accuracy.mjs && node tests/screw-photo-variations.mjs && node tests/autotrace-resolution.mjs
scripts.test:autotrace:model: npm run prepare:photos && node tests/trained-segmentation-browser.cjs && node tests/trained-segmentation-accuracy.mjs
scripts.test:autotrace:release: npm test && npm run verify:models && npm run test:autotrace:complex && npm run test:autotrace:photos && npm run test:autotrace:model && npm run test:autotrace:model:threads && npm run test:autotrace:ui && npm run test:autotrace:edit && npm run test:autotrace:model:ui
scripts.pack:mac: node build/pack.mjs --platform darwin --arch arm64 && node build/pack.mjs --platform darwin --arch x64
